reference_sql:
WITH base AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025 and account with MRR at the end of the month before
  SELECT CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) AS month_start, m.account_id
  FROM mrr_monthly m
  WHERE m.month BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2025-11-01'
), churned AS (
  -- one row per account and month with a churn event
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_type = 'churn' AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT b.month_start, COUNT(*) AS accounts_at_start, COUNT(c.account_id) AS churned_accounts
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN churned c ON c.account_id = b.account_id AND c.month_start = b.month_start
GROUP BY b.month_start

WITH starts AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025: the accounts with MRR at the end of the month before
  SELECT CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS accounts_at_start
  FROM mrr_monthly m
  WHERE m.month BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2025-11-01'
  GROUP BY CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)
), churns AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025 with a churn event
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS churned_accounts
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_type = 'churn' AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', event_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT s.month_start, s.accounts_at_start, COALESCE(c.churned_accounts, 0) AS churned_accounts
FROM starts s
LEFT JOIN churns c ON c.month_start = s.month_start

SELECT CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS accounts_at_start,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM subscription_events e
    WHERE e.account_id = m.account_id AND e.event_type = 'churn'
      AND e.event_date >= m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AND e.event_date < m.month + INTERVAL 2 MONTH)) AS churned_accounts
FROM mrr_monthly m
WHERE m.month BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2025-11-01'
GROUP BY CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)

solver.query:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT CAST(m AS DATE) AS month_start
  FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2025-12-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS g(m)
),
base AS (
  SELECT mo.month_start, b.account_id
  FROM months mo
  JOIN mrr_monthly b ON CAST(b.month AS DATE) = CAST(mo.month_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)
),
churn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(date_trunc('month', CAST(event_date AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS month_start, account_id
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_type = 'churn'
)
SELECT mo.month_start,
       COUNT(b.account_id) AS accounts_at_start,
       COUNT(c.account_id) AS churned_accounts
FROM months mo
LEFT JOIN base b ON b.month_start = mo.month_start
LEFT JOIN churn c ON c.month_start = b.month_start AND c.account_id = b.account_id
GROUP BY mo.month_start
